title: Learning Optimal Transport Plans Via Autoregressive Token Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.22218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for finding the minimum cost coupling between probability distributions. Classical solvers remain the gold standard for this task. At the same time, OT is an ideal testbed for studying whether learning-based amortized models can internalize the structure of OT type problems. Here, ground-truth solutions are available and marginal constraints are explicitly defined. Also, exact discrete solutions have well-characterized sparsity. We describe ToR-OT, a transformer-based model that learns to predict discrete OT plans through autoregressive token regression. We reframe OT into a structured sequence generation task. ToR-OT decodes sparse transport plans as sequences instead of solving an optimization task at test time. translated_title: 通过自回归标记回归学习最优传输方案
translated_abstract: 最优传输为寻找概率分布之间的最小成本耦合提供了一个有原则性的框架。经典求解器仍然是该任务的黄金标准。与此同时，OT是研究基于学习的摊销模型能否内化OT类问题结构的理想测试平台。在这一问题中，真值解是可获得的，边际约束被显式定义，且精确的离散解具有充分刻画的稀疏性。我们提出了ToR-OT，一个基于Transformer的模型，通过自回归标记回归学习预测离散OT方案。我们将OT重新构建为一个结构化序列生成任务，ToR-OT将稀疏传输方案解码为序列，而不是在测试时求解优化问题。我们关注三个性质：(a) 零样本泛化：在大型合成OT实例语料库上进行预训练，使单个模型能够泛化到未见过的分布……
tldr: 该论文提出ToR-OT，一种基于Transformer的自回归标记回归模型，将最优传输问题重构为结构化序列生成任务，直接解码稀疏传输方案而无需在测试时求解优化问题，并展现出零样本泛化到未见分布的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ToR-OT, a transformer-based autoregressive token regression model that reformulates Optimal Transport as a structured sequence generation task, directly decoding sparse transport plans without solving optimization at test time, demonstrating zero-shot generalization to unseen distributions.
